svg.title: CareConnect - Transaction
svg.desc: One of exactly six screen designs. All shown names, records, amounts and chart values are illustrative layout data. Reference style: white header, teal navigation, pale background and rounded cards.
svg.text: Confirm your clinic and copay. Your HSA charge and audit entry are saved together.
Enter a positive amount with up to two decimal places.
Copay must be greater than zero.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / success
g.text: Audit entry created by the trigger

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / low-balance
g.text: Your HSA balance is too low
This copay is higher than your available balance.
Enter a lower amount, then try again.
No booking, debit or audit entry was saved.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / active-visit
g.text: You already have an active visit
Your Waiting or In consultation appointment must
be discharged by clinic staff before booking again.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / invalid-copay
g.text: Enter an amount greater than zero with no more
Correct the highlighted field before submitting.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / request-failed
g.text: We could not confirm your booking
Keep the same booking details and retry.
Check your appointments before starting a new request.
The result may be uncertain; do not submit a different booking.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / submitting
g.text: Please wait. Keep these booking details unchanged.

g.inkscape:label: Transaction / no accepting clinics
g.text: Choose another clinic in Browse or try again later.
Booking is unavailable until an accepting clinic is selected.

svg.text: Illustrative layout values only. Amounts are HSA account units; the schema specifies no currency.
